no_token.en: No API token. Create one on the website (Profile -> Personal API tokens), then export SURVEY26_TOKEN or run `survey26 login --token-stdin`.
no_token.zh: 没有 API 令牌。请在网站「个人资料 → 个人 API 令牌」中创建，然后设置 SURVEY26_TOKEN 环境变量或运行 `survey26 login --token-stdin`。

invalid_token.en: This API token is not valid (mistyped, revoked, or deleted). Create a new one on your profile page.
invalid_token.zh: API 令牌无效（输入错误、已撤销或已删除）。请在个人资料页重新创建。

cli_tokens_disabled.en: API tokens are not available right now.
cli_tokens_disabled.zh: API 令牌功能暂未开放。

rate_limited.en: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
rate_limited.zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍等一分钟再试。

network_error.en: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
network_error.zh: 无法连接服务器，请检查网络后重试。

gateway_unavailable.en: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
gateway_unavailable.zh: 服务器暂时不可用，请稍后再试。

session_unavailable.en: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
session_unavailable.zh: 服务器暂时不可用，请稍后再试。

action_not_available.en: This action is not available with an API token.
action_not_available.zh: 该操作不能通过 API 令牌使用。

confirmation_required.en: This action needs confirmation: run it again with --yes.
confirmation_required.zh: 该操作需要确认：请加上 --yes 重新运行。

wait_timeout.en: Still not finished when the wait timed out. Run the wait command again later.
wait_timeout.zh: 等待超时，任务仍未结束。请稍后再次运行等待命令。

ambiguous_id.en: This ID prefix matches more than one item. Use more characters.
ambiguous_id.zh: 该 ID 前缀匹配到多个对象，请多输入几位。

no_open_phase.zh: 当前没有开放的评测赛程。

revision_not_reviewable.en: This version is not ready for confirmation (it must be ready for review).
revision_not_reviewable.zh: 该版本尚不能确认（需处于“等待确认”状态）。

no_team_version.en: No final version yet. Confirm a version and evaluate it, or choose one.
no_team_version.zh: 还没有最终版本。请先确认并评测一个版本，或在下方选择。

invalid_api_response.zh: 服务器返回了无法识别的内容。

team_required.en: Join or create a team first.

stale_approval.en: The version changed. Reopen the review before confirming.
stale_approval.zh: 版本已变化，请重新打开并检查。

batch_already_active.en: Your team already has an active evaluation.
batch_already_active.zh: 本队已有正在进行的评测。

preparation_limit.en: Your team already has three projects being prepared.
preparation_limit.zh: 本队已有三个项目正在准备，请等待完成。

preparation_daily_limit.en: Your team has used today’s project preparations (the daily number follows the evaluation quota; see survey26 quota). The count resets at 00:00 UTC (08:00 Beijing time).
preparation_daily_limit.zh: 本队今天的项目准备次数已用完（每天的次数与评测次数相同，可用 survey26 quota 查看），每天北京时间 8 点（UTC 0 点）重置。

daily_limit.en: The daily evaluation limit has been reached.
daily_limit.zh: 今天的评测次数已用完。

repeat_daily_limit.en: Evaluate 3 times and average needs 3 of today’s evaluations.
repeat_daily_limit.zh: 「评测 3 次取平均」需要今天剩余至少 3 次评测。

revision_already_evaluated.en: This version has already been evaluated. Pass --yes to evaluate it again (uses one more of today’s evaluations).
revision_already_evaluated.zh: 这个版本已经评测过。再评测一次会再占用今天 1 次评测，请加上 --yes。

revision_not_withdrawable.en: Only versions that are not being prepared and were never evaluated can be withdrawn.
revision_not_withdrawable.zh: 只能撤回未在准备中、也从未评测过的版本。

revision_not_found.en: No such version of your team.
revision_not_found.zh: 找不到本队的这个版本。

revision_not_ready.en: This version is not ready yet.
revision_not_ready.zh: 这个版本还没有准备好。

revision_not_approved.en: Only a confirmed version can be chosen.
revision_not_approved.zh: 只能选择已确认的版本。

wrong_file_type.en: Choose a file with the required extension.
wrong_file_type.zh: 请选择要求的文件类型。

file_too_large.en: The file is empty or exceeds the size limit.
file_too_large.zh: 文件为空或超过大小限制。

invalid_repository_url.en: Enter a public GitHub link: https://github.com/owner/repository, optionally with /tree/<branch>/<folder> or /commit/<sha>.
invalid_repository_url.zh: 请输入公开 GitHub 仓库链接：https://github.com/owner/repository，可带 /tree/分支/子目录 或 /commit/提交号。

repository_not_found.en: This GitHub repository was not found. Check the owner and name, and that it is public.
repository_not_found.zh: 找不到这个 GitHub 仓库，请检查用户名、仓库名，并确认仓库是公开的。

source_ref_not_found.en: This branch, tag or commit does not exist in the repository.
source_ref_not_found.zh: 仓库里没有这个分支、标签或 commit。

source_subdir_not_found.en: This folder does not exist at that branch or commit (folder names are case-sensitive).
source_subdir_not_found.zh: 在这个分支或 commit 中找不到该子目录（区分大小写）。

source_options_conflict.en: The branch or folder in the link differs from --branch/--subdir. Keep only one of them.
source_options_conflict.zh: 链接里的分支或子目录与 --branch/--subdir 不一致，请只保留一处。

invalid_source_ref.en: The branch, tag or commit name is not valid.
invalid_source_ref.zh: 分支、标签或 commit 名称格式不正确。

invalid_source_subdir.en: Enter the folder as a relative path such as agent or apps/agent.
invalid_source_subdir.zh: 子目录请填写相对路径，例如 agent 或 apps/agent。

source_options_unavailable.en: Branch and folder choices are temporarily unavailable. Submit the plain repository link, or upload a ZIP.
source_options_unavailable.zh: 暂时不支持指定分支或子目录，请提交仓库主页链接，或上传 ZIP。

invalid_source_archive.en: This folder contains links or files that cannot be packaged. Upload the project as a ZIP instead.
invalid_source_archive.zh: 该目录包含符号链接或无法打包的文件，请改为上传 ZIP。

private_source_requires_zip.en: This repository is private. Make it public, or upload the project as a ZIP.
private_source_requires_zip.zh: 这个仓库是私有的。请把它设为公开，或改为上传 ZIP。

source_too_large.en: The repository archive is larger than 100 MB. Upload a smaller ZIP of the project instead.
source_too_large.zh: 仓库压缩包超过 100 MB，请改为上传精简后的项目 ZIP。

source_snapshot_unavailable.en: Could not save a copy of this repository version right now. Please try again in a minute.
source_snapshot_unavailable.zh: 暂时无法保存该仓库版本的副本，请稍后再试。

invalid_team_variable.en: Invalid name or value: use upper-case letters, digits and underscores, not a reserved name; the value must not be empty and at most 8 KB.
invalid_team_variable.zh: 变量名或值不符合要求：变量名使用大写字母、数字和下划线，不能使用平台保留的名称；值不能为空且不超过 8 KB。

no_model_not_available.en: "Without a model" (--no-model) is only for project evaluations in the online competition and practice, not the hidden final.
no_model_not_available.zh: 「本次不提供模型」（--no-model）只能用于线上赛和练习的项目评测，不能用于隐藏卡决赛。

team_variable_not_found.en: No team variable with this name. See survey26 env show.
team_variable_not_found.zh: 没有这个名称的队伍变量，可用 survey26 env show 查看。

team_variable_limit.en: The variable limit has been reached; delete a variable you no longer use first.
team_variable_limit.zh: 变量数量已达上限，请先删除不再使用的变量。

invalid_egress_route.en: Choose an egress route: direct, cn or overseas.
invalid_egress_route.zh: 请选择出网线路：direct（直连）、cn（回国代理）或 overseas（海外代理）。

egress_route_unavailable.en: Egress routes are not offered right now; evaluations connect directly.
egress_route_unavailable.zh: 出网线路暂未开放，评测直接连接。

invalid_team_domains.en: Invalid domain: enter the name only (e.g. api.kimi.com), without https://, a port or a path, and not an IP address or internal name; at most 10.
invalid_team_domains.zh: 域名格式不正确：只填写域名本身（例如 api.kimi.com），不含 https://、端口或路径，不能是 IP 地址或内网名称；最多 10 个。

team_domain_not_public.en: This domain does not resolve right now, or resolves to a non-public address, so it cannot be added.
team_domain_not_public.zh: 这个域名目前无法解析，或解析到了非公网地址，不能添加。

final_version_locked.en: The online phase has ended; the final version can no longer change.
final_version_locked.zh: 线上赛已结束，最终版本不能再修改。

upload_limit.en: Too many uploads are still pending for your team. Wait a few minutes for them to clear, then try again.
upload_limit.zh: 本队有太多上传正在等待处理，请等几分钟后再试一次。

upload_failed.en: The file upload failed, possibly due to the network. Please try again.
upload_failed.zh: 文件上传失败，可能是网络问题，请重试。

upload_not_found.en: The upload session expired or could not be found. Upload the file again.
upload_not_found.zh: 上传会话已过期或找不到，请重新上传。

upload_not_finished.en: The file has not finished uploading yet. Wait a moment and try again.
upload_not_finished.zh: 文件还没有上传完成，请稍等再试一次。

zip_has_no_code.en: No code files were found in the ZIP. Make sure you zipped the folder that contains your program, or start from an official example (the examples include observer.project.json).
zip_has_no_code.zh: 压缩包里没有找到代码文件。请确认打包的是包含程序的文件夹，或参考官方示例，示例自带 observer.project.json。

portal_unavailable.en: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
portal_unavailable.zh: 无法连接服务器，请检查网络后重试。

phase_closed.en: This phase is not taking evaluations right now.
phase_closed.zh: 这个赛程现在不接受评测。

projects_not_enabled.en: Project evaluation is not open for the current competition.
projects_not_enabled.zh: 当前比赛尚未开放项目评测。

result_not_ready.en: This card has no result yet.

project_not_ready.en: This project version cannot be downloaded yet.
project_not_ready.zh: 该项目版本暂时无法下载。

run_not_found.en: No such run of your team.
run_not_found.zh: 找不到本队的这次运行。

already_in_team.en: You are already on a team.
already_in_team.zh: 你已经在一个队伍里了。

bad_code.en: That invite code is not right.

locked.en: This team is locked and not taking new members.
locked.zh: 这个队伍已锁定，不再接受新成员。

name_length.zh: 队伍名需要 2–60 个字符。

name_taken.zh: 这个队伍名已经有人用了。

bad_size.en: Team size must be between 1 and 3, and not below the current member count.
bad_size.zh: 队伍人数上限要在 1 到 3 之间，且不少于现有人数。

leader_only.en: Only the team leader can do this.
leader_only.zh: 只有队长能做这项操作。

leader_must_transfer.en: You are the leader: hand leadership to someone else before leaving.
leader_must_transfer.zh: 你是队长，退出前请先把队长转给别人。

has_submissions.en: This team already has submissions, so it cannot be disbanded or emptied.
has_submissions.zh: 这个队伍已经有提交记录，不能解散或清空。

not_in_team.en: You are not on a team.
not_in_team.zh: 你现在不在任何队伍里。

not_member.en: That person is not on your team.
not_member.zh: 这个人不是你们队的成员。

cannot_remove_leader.en: The leader cannot be removed from the team.

need_team.en: Create or join a team first.

team_limit_reached.en: All team places are taken and registration is closed, so no new team can be created. You can still join an existing team with an invite code.
team_limit_reached.zh: 参赛队伍已满，报名已关闭，不能再创建新队伍。你仍可以用邀请码加入已有队伍。

recipient_unavailable.en: This person cannot currently receive a team invitation.
recipient_unavailable.zh: 对方目前无法接收组队邀请。

team_unavailable.en: This team is no longer available.
team_unavailable.zh: 这个队伍目前不可加入。

invitation_not_found.en: This request is not addressed to you.
invitation_not_found.zh: 你不是这条请求的接收方。

invitation_finished.en: This request has already been handled.
invitation_finished.zh: 这条请求已经处理完毕。

no_codes_left.en: No codes left from this provider.
no_codes_left.zh: 这家的兑换码已经领完了。

already_assigned.en: This team already has a code from this provider.
already_assigned.zh: 这个队伍已经有这家的兑换码了。

captain_only.en: Only the team captain can claim the Kimi Coding Plan code.
captain_only.zh: 只有队长可以领取 Kimi Coding Plan 兑换码。

not_eligible.en: Your team needs one successful score in the practice round first.
not_eligible.zh: 你的队伍还需在练习赛获得一次成功评分。

nickname_too_long.en: Nickname must be 40 characters or fewer.

avatar_bad_type.en: Please choose a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.
avatar_bad_type.zh: 请选择 PNG、JPG 或 WEBP 图片。

avatar_too_large.en: That image is larger than 2 MB.

avatar_invalid_image.en: This file is not a readable image.

invalid_field.en: A field is missing or invalid.
invalid_field.zh: 有字段缺失或不符合要求。

invalid_uid.en: A UID is the 9-digit number shown at the bottom right of the website (e.g. 100000123).
invalid_uid.zh: UID 是网站右下角显示的 9 位数字（例如 100000123）。

uid_unavailable.en: No one can be reached with this UID. Check the number.
uid_unavailable.zh: 无法通过这个 UID 找到可添加的人，请检查号码。

uid_not_found.en: No participant has this UID. Check the number.
uid_not_found.zh: 没有参赛者使用这个 UID，请检查号码。

uid_daily_limit.en: You have used today's 20 actions by UID. Try again tomorrow.
uid_daily_limit.zh: 今天通过 UID 添加或邀请的 20 次机会已用完，请明天再试。

blocked_by_you.en: You have blocked this person. Unblock them first.
blocked_by_you.zh: 你已屏蔽此人，请先解除屏蔽。

recipient_in_team.en: This person is already on a team.
recipient_in_team.zh: 对方已经在一个队伍里了。

request_not_found.en: This friend request is not addressed to you.
request_not_found.zh: 你不是这条好友请求的接收方。

request_finished.en: This friend request has already been handled.
request_finished.zh: 这条好友请求已经处理完毕。

not_friends.en: You are not friends with this person.
